name: robots/universalrobots__universal_robots_ros2_driver
title: Universal Robots ROS 2 dashboard client
intro: Universal Robots ROS 2 dashboard client, adapted from universalrobots/universal_robots_ros2_driver. It reads `read_program_running`; runs `stop_dashboard_program`. `stop_dashboard_program`: stop the active dashboard program through the acknowledged UR dashboard stop service; this does not command joint motion or claim a physical emergency stop. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
